evaluations.rationale: The incumbent patch remains the best artifact and is the fallback, but it has no new check. It is rescored and deferred to the chain experiment, which tests a failure mode not covered by one-hop evidence.
Selected. Multi-hop re-injection is the most plausible way the one-hop repair could fail and is directly executable on the existing fixture. It also gives both APIs a shared expected header set.
Deferred, not refuted. The default-port and relative-Location control is strong but overlaps the selected chain action, so it is folded into the same run rather than repeated as a separate round.

Deferred, not refuted. Duplicate-header and challenge survival are useful over-strip controls and are folded into the selected robustness script, but they do not discriminate a state-persistence failure.
